description: Build a three-cup pyramid from one nested stack, then collapse it back into one nested stack.

atomic_actions.label: build_three_cup_pyramid
atomic_actions.instruction: Separate the three nested cups and build a stable pyramid with two cups on the bottom and one cup on top.

atomic_actions.label: collapse_pyramid_to_nested_stack
atomic_actions.instruction: Dismantle the three-cup pyramid and collect all cups into one stable nested stack.
